description: Experiment 2, closed loop (SC8, spec section 6.2): one shared lab run per seed, the pH loop run once per arm with the same draws (common random numbers through the canonical key), the oracle against A, B and C. The seed list is written here before any run (docs/prompts/20 Step 4). At least 20 seeds (A103, the minimum in data/scenarios/evaluation/default.json), neutral integers, none date-shaped (00 section 2 item 2). The list is a plain list of integers chosen by hand; it is not a function of any result. The variant is a sensitivity (C subtracts the open-sample offset of A041 instead of excluding the value), reported and never gated. The bootstrap settings are computation settings of the report: a seed for the keyed stream and the number of resamples.
